import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,pathlib,sys
p=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for name in ['coprime','group','switching']:
 z=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/f'sources/{name}.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert z.returncode==0
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{name}.txt'],input=z.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print('BODY',name, 'characters',len(z.stdout));print(z.stdout[:19000] if name!='switching' else z.stdout[:4500]+z.stdout[-17000:])
